title: GraphQL endpoint present, introspection disabled (/v1/graphql)
summary: A GraphQL endpoint answers here and explicitly refuses introspection. This is good inventory: the service is in use and hardened against schema disclosure. No action is needed beyond keeping it off.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.

reproduce: curl -s 'https://host/v1/graphql?query=%7B__schema%7BqueryType%7Bname%7D%7D%7D'  # the body says introspection is not allowed
remediate: No action needed. Introspection is already off. Keep it off in production.
